answer: Adaptive Cadence Gate: each identity accrues credit only while its transaction inter-arrival times match a slowly shifting traffic baseline, tracked like a dune migrating grain by grain. Identities whose timing variance stays within tolerance keep a copper-grade routing weight; those deviating are throttled to a reef of low-priority queues. Registering many fresh identities yields near-zero credit until each sustains plausible cadence for hours, so a sybil swarm pays real wall-clock time per fake identity plus queue delay on every message.
